options.name: action
options.description: Action of the packet filter.

options.name: alert_enabled
options.description: Controls if this filter should be alerted on.

options.name: any_flags
options.description: True if any flags are used.

options.name: context_id
options.description: ID of the schedule to control when this filter is 'on'.

options.name: description
options.description: Description of the firewall rule

options.name: destination_iplist_id
options.description: ID of destination IP list. Only applies to destination IP type 'ip-list'.

options.name: destination_ipmask
options.description: Destination IP mask. Only applies to destination IP type 'masked-ip'.

options.name: destination_ipmultiple
options.description: List of comma-delimited destination IP addresses. Only applies to destination IP type 'multiple'.

options.name: destination_ipnot
options.description: Controls if the destination IP setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: destination_iprange_from
options.description: The first value for a range of destination IP addresses. Only applies to estination IP type 'range'.

options.name: destination_iprange_to
options.description: The last value for a range of destination IP addresses. Only applies to destination IP type 'range'.

options.name: destination_iptype
options.description: Destination IP type.

options.name: destination_ipvalue
options.description: Destination IP. Only applies to destination IP type 'masked-ip' or 'single'.

options.name: destination_maclist_id
options.description: ID of MAC address list. Only applies to MAC type 'mac-list'.

options.name: destination_macmultiple
options.description: List of comma-delimited MAC addresses. Only applies to MAC type 'multiple'.

options.name: destination_macnot
options.description: Controls if the destination MAC setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: destination_mactype
options.description: Destination MAC type.

options.name: destination_macvalue
options.description: Destination MAC address. Only applies to MAC type 'single'.

options.name: destination_port_list_id
options.description: ID of destination port list. Only applies to destination type 'port-list'.

options.name: destination_port_multiple
options.description: List of comma-delimited destination ports. Only applies to destination type 'multiple'.

options.name: destination_port_not
options.description: Controls if the destination port setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: destination_port_type
options.description: The type of destination port.

options.name: direction
options.description: Packet direction.

options.name: frame_not
options.description: Controls if the frame setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: frame_number
options.description: Ethernet frame number. Only required for FrameType 'other'.

options.name: frame_type
options.description: Supported frame types.

options.name: icmpcode
options.description: ICMPCode

options.name: icmpnot
options.description: ICMP Not

options.name: icmptype
options.description: ICMP Type

options.name: include_packet_data
options.description: Controls if this filter should capture data for every log.

options.name: log_disabled
options.description: Controls if logging for this filter is disabled. Only applies to filter action 'log-only' or 'deny'.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the firewall rule

options.name: priority
options.description: Priority of the packet filter.

options.name: protocol
options.description: Protocol.

options.name: protocol_not
options.description: Controls if the protocol setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: protocol_number
options.description: Two-byte protocol number.

options.name: source_iplist_id
options.description: ID of source IP list. Only applies to source IP type 'ip-list'.

options.name: source_ipmask
options.description: Source IP mask. Only applies to source IP type 'masked-ip'.

options.name: source_ipmultiple
options.description: List of source IP addresses. Only applies to source IP type 'multiple'.

options.name: source_ipnot
options.description: Controls if the source IP setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: source_iprange_from
options.description: The first value for a range of source IP addresses. Only applies to source IP type 'range'.

options.name: source_iprange_to
options.description: The last value for a range of source IP addresses. Only applies to source IP type 'range'.

options.name: source_iptype
options.description: Source IP type.

options.name: source_ipvalue
options.description: Source IP. Only applies to source IP type 'masked-ip' or 'single'.

options.name: source_maclist_id
options.description: ID of MAC address list. Only applies to MAC type 'mac-list'.

options.name: source_macmultiple
options.description: List of MAC addresses. Only applies to MAC type 'multiple'.

options.name: source_macnot
options.description: Controls if the source MAC setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: source_mactype
options.description: Source MAC type.

options.name: source_macvalue
options.description: Source MAC address. Only applies to MAC type 'single'.

options.name: source_port_list_id
options.description: ID of source port list. Only applies to source type 'port-list'.

options.name: source_port_multiple
options.description: List of comma-delimited source ports. Only applies to source type 'multiple'.

options.name: source_port_not
options.description: Controls if the source MAC setting should be inverted. Set to true to invert.

options.name: source_port_type
options.description: The type of source port.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in

options.name: tcpflags
options.description: TCP flags

options.name: tcpnot
options.description: TCP Not
